payout_quote: To earn the $400 bonus, open your first eligible Connect Credit Union Checking Account and receive a total of at least $250 in qualifying direct deposits within 60 days after opening the account. Once the requirements are completed and verified, the bonus will be deposited within 60 days.
steps: Confirm Connect Credit Union membership eligibility (FL State employee, FDOT retiree/contractor employee, family of a member, or live/work in one of the 31 listed FL counties) and open membership with a Share Savings account.
Open your first eligible Connect Checking or eChecking account between 9/15/26 and 12/15/26 at https://www.connectcu.org/400-bonus-new-checking.
Receive a total of at least $250 in qualifying payroll or retirement-benefit direct deposits within 60 days of opening; the $400 bonus is deposited within 60 days after verification.
catches: Connect Credit Union membership required: FL State employees, FDOT retirees, FDOT-contractor employees, immediate family of members, or live/work in one of 31 eligible FL counties.
Offer available only to members who have never previously had a Connect checking account (new and current members without checking both OK).
Open an eligible Checking or eChecking account between 9/15/26 and 12/15/26; receive $250+ in qualifying payroll or retirement-benefit DD within 60 days of opening.
Qualifying DD = electronic deposit by an employer/payroll provider or retirement fund; transfers, person-to-person, cash, and check deposits do not count.
Connect Checking has a $2.75/month Account Security Fee (waivable with combined-balance requirement); account must remain open and in good standing through bonus payment.
Bonus may be reported for tax purposes.
biggest_catch: Florida-only membership, and only people who never had a Connect CU checking account qualify — even existing members with a past checking account are out.
eligibility: Connect CU members (new or current) who have never had a Connect checking account; must qualify for CU membership (FL State employee, FDOT retiree, FDOT-contractor employee, family of member, or live/work in 31 listed FL counties).
timing: $400 bonus deposited directly into the new checking account within 60 days after requirements are verified.
